title: Shackleton's Lost Ship Was Found 9,869 Feet Underwater

scenes.text: Shackleton's ship was found 107 years after it sank.
Endurance was crushed by ice in Antarctica in 1915.
It lay almost ten thousand feet down in the Weddell Sea.
It was only about four miles from where it went down.
The ship sat upright and looked remarkably intact.
The name Endurance was still visible across the stern. A hundred years under the ice, and it still has its name.

description:
Shackleton's ship was found 107 years after it sank.
The Endurance was crushed by ice in 1915 and found upright in 2022, 3,008 meters down in the Weddell Sea, with its name still visible on the stern.
What would you hope to find on a wreck?
first_comment: Bonus: it was only about four miles from where it was crushed in 1915. Would you have gone looking for it?
